patient.social_context: Several friends use at parties; a roommate has voiced concern
patient.background: Fictional student and part-time barista who shares a house with roommates.
patient.history_summary: Non-prescribed pill use that started at parties in 2023 and became weekly in late 2024.
patient.treatment_summary: No treatment so far; received referral information at an emergency visit in 2025 and has not yet followed it up.

history_events.description: First use of non-prescribed pills at a party.
Use moves from occasional parties to most weekends.
Visits an emergency department after a frightening episode and receives written referral information.
Asks a roommate to help him look for an appointment.

factors.description: Parties and gatherings where friends use.
Money worries; has borrowed from friends.
Family history of substance use: unknown.
A roommate who is concerned and willing to help.

interventions.reported_outcome: Received written referral information; has not yet contacted the service.

progress.note: Open to talking; has not contacted the referral service.
Reports using on more days than six months earlier.
Has asked a roommate to help find an appointment; none booked yet.
